article.title: Federal Reserve keeps rates unchanged despite elevated inflation
article.description: The Fed raised its benchmark rate last month for the first time in three years, defying President Donald Trump’s demands for rate cuts, in an effort to get inflation back to its 2% target in a “timelier” manner. The post Federal Reserve keeps rates unchanged despite elevated inflation appeared first on Boston.com .

summary.zh_summary: 美联储上个月首次在三年内提高基准利率，尽管特朗普总统要求降息。
summary.en_title: Federal Reserve keeps rates unchanged despite elevated inflation
summary.en_summary: The Fed raised its benchmark rate last month for the first time in three years, defying President Donald Trump’s demands for rate cuts.

article.description: Concerning projections from hyperscalers this week punished tech stocks and pushed the Nasdaq to its first three-week losing streak since March.

article.title: Fed holds interest rates steady even as inflation remains stubborn
article.description: The Federal Reserve opted to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged  — but investors widely expect the central bank to raise rates at its next meeting in December to combat stubborn inflation.

summary.zh_title: 美联储在通胀顽固的情况下维持利率稳定
summary.zh_summary: 美联储选择维持基准利率不变，但投资者普遍预计中央银行将在12月的下一次会议上提高利率以应对顽固的通胀。
summary.en_title: Fed holds interest rates steady even as inflation remains stubborn
summary.en_summary: The Federal Reserve opted to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged — but investors widely expect the central bank to raise rates at its next meeting in December.

article.title: Mixed economic forecast weighs heavy ahead of midterms
article.description: There was a mixed Halloween bag of economic news this week. GDP growth is up, but so are prices. For now at least, interest rates are staying the same. What does that mean for the midterm elections?

article.title: Rivals in Israel Election Strike Tone of Triumph, but Outcome Is Far From Clear
